name: Membership Card
description: Membership card of a club or association.
summary: Credential type template for VerifiableCredential,MembershipCard, a membership card in jwt_vc_vcdm format, without a schema. Subject form groups: Member (firstName, familyName) and Membership (membershipNumber, validUntil). Issued by the NOOP VPDriven and CredentialRequirements example wallet templates, which pre-fill the member's name from, or gate issuance on, a presented National ID.
